title: Wanxing public read surfaces — consumer contract
description: The response shapes that sibling lines rely on. Only consumed fields are constrained; anything else may be added freely (additive changes do not bump the revision). Bumping x-contract-rev is required for any rename, removal, or semantic change of a field named here. Consumers: paas/scripts/plaza-export.mjs (catalog export — reads the projection counters below as a hard gate), paas/facet/supply-catalog.js (spine), paas/server/routes/fleets.js (owner cross-line), paas/services/ops-console (fleet board), fd-lex (copilot loader — not covered here, see copilot.js contract), fd-wire (A2A receipt — covered by /turn below), wanxing-ops-mcp (catalog + card), fd-industry-data (A2A work-order dispatch).

facadeCatalogResponse.description: GET /api/facades-catalog — the public facade projection. Consumers: paas/scripts/plaza-export.mjs (facades + the two projection counters), paas/facet/supply-catalog.js (producer).

facades.description: Projected facade entries. A malformed upstream row never appears here — it is counted in `dropped` instead.

dropped.description: Upstream rows the projection discarded entirely (missing/unusable id). Consumed by plaza-export as a hard gate: >0 fails the export, because the plaza would otherwise publish a silently shorter catalog.

coerced.description: Rows kept although a required field was not a string (blank fields are published). Consumed by plaza-export as a hard gate.

viewer.description: Serving plane's own admission result; reserved, not an authorisation decision.

source_absent.description: Present only when the upstream feed is unconfigured or has never landed. Absence is honest (empty array), never a fabricated row.

dataAnchorsCatalogResponse.description: GET /api/data-anchors-catalog — the DAAS data-anchor projection. Consumers: paas/scripts/plaza-export.mjs (anchors + the two projection counters), paas/facet/supply-catalog.js (producer).

anchors.description: Projected data-anchor entries (official-data species). Same drop discipline as the facade face.

dropped.description: Upstream rows the projection discarded entirely (missing/unusable id). Consumed by plaza-export as a hard gate.

coerced.description: Rows kept although a required field was not a string. Consumed by plaza-export as a hard gate.

as_of.description: Upstream snapshot instant the projection was computed against.

source_absent.description: Present only when the upstream feed is unconfigured or has never landed.

agentsResponse.description: GET /api/wanxing/v1/agents — the deployed-instance view. Consumers: paas/facet/supply-catalog.js (every field below), wanxing-ops-mcp (browse tool).

page.description: Present only on a paged request.

page_size.description: Present only on a paged request.

total.description: Present only on a paged request; counts the filtered set.

facets.description: Present only when facets=1. Computed over the UNFILTERED public list.

clusters.description: Distinct cluster ids over the UNFILTERED public list (chips render whole, so the count never moves when a filter is applied).

slug.description: Public route identity. The spine joins its deployment bookkeeping by this value.

examples.description: Declared example prompts; absent when undeclared.

chatable.description: Chatability marker. Absent when not chatable. The spine copies this verbatim into the supply catalog.

category.description: Curation LABEL from the packs table. Absent when uncurated — that never hides the entry.

featured.description: Curation label; only ever present as true.

turns7d.description: External turns (api+chat) in the last 7 days. Honest zero.

cluster.description: Present only for members of a cluster-declaring pack.

status.description: Live instance status, derived from the deployment pause flag plus turns7d. The spine passes this through unchanged into its facade species.

status_as_of.description: The snapshot instant the status was derived from — lets a consumer tell a fresh 'idle' from a frozen 'unknown'.

opsUsageResponse.description: GET /api/wanxing/v1/ops/usage — service-credential only. Consumer: paas/server/routes/fleets.js filters byCaller by email.

email.description: The owner cross-line view matches on this.

fleetBoardResponse.description: GET /api/fleet/v1/board — observer board behind the facade's console gate. Consumer: paas/services/ops-console (renders every field below).

states.description: state name → count (latest per agent within the states window).

states_window.description: The window the `states` distribution is counted over — not the top-level `window`. Consumers must label the pills with this, or a 2h distribution reads as a 24h one.

runner_liveness.description: Explicit liveness beside the 30-minute snapshot: `runners` answers "what did it last say", this answers "is it still there". ABSENT semantics are the point — a runner missing here is not reported alive. Consumer: wanxing-web OpsView.

last_seen_at.description: The runner's last beat, ms epoch. null only when the row exists without a timestamp.

age_ms.description: now - last_seen_at, clamped at 0. This is the number the legend thresholds on.

beats.description: Cumulative beat count for the runner.

presence.description: ok = fresh beat; stale = late but inside tolerance; lost = silence we are willing to call a loss. Three states, never two — none of them may collapse into 'absent' (a runner missing from this map is not reported alive).

leases.description: Work leases over the lease window. Present even when empty, because "no sender yet" and "nothing stuck" must not render alike — `available` is the difference, and OpsView renders three distinct states from it.

available.description: false = no lease event has ever been seen (the sender never came up).

state.description: claimed | renewed | expired — the kind suffix.

cells.description: Freshest cell_stats per cell identity within the 30-minute window (id → row, latest wins — these are snapshots, not an event stream). Deliberately NOT folded into agents/states: cell identities would blur the resident picture. Consumer: wanxing-web OpsView/FleetView.

shortterm.description: Counters summed over the same cell_stats rows: how many cells reported, what their executions and workers are doing right now. Consumer: wanxing-web OpsView.

agent_health.description: Per-agent health from the observer's own pass (surface-silent-agent-failures): a stale pass refreshes on demand so a panel never reads an empty section. Consumers index it BY `agent`, so that key is the join. wanxing-web FleetView + OpsView.

agent.description: The join key consumers index by.

consecutive.description: Leading streak of failed TURNS (not hours) — a low-traffic agent that failed twice is not '3 hours bad'.

consecutiveHours.description: Same streak counted in hourly buckets (kept for the web's hour read).

declared_every_ms.description: Present only for agents that declare a rhythm: the period they promised.

expected_turns.description: Present only with a declared rhythm: how many turns the window implies.

health.description: ok | silent | degraded | failing | paused; null only for a stale (unjudged) entry. OpsView filters on failing/degraded.

lastErrorKind.description: The cause of the latest error (classified kind, or 'budget'/'unknown'); null when the window had no errors.

since.description: When the current state began (ms epoch); null when unjudged.

stale.description: Always present. true = the pause flag could not be read this pass, so the entry is unjudged rather than healthy.

stalled.description: Present only when 'should have run at least stallMinExpected times, ran zero'. This is what separates 'nobody used it' from 'it should have fired and did not'.

window_hours.description: The health window the counters were folded over (hours). Consumers must label the panel with this, or a 3-hour count reads as a 24-hour one.

missions.description: Mission roll-up from the event stream (id → status/trail/spent folded from mission events). Consumer: wanxing-web MissionsView.

turnReceipt.description: POST /api/wanxing/v1/a2a/{slug} (JSON-RPC message/send) — the synchronous receipt shape fd-wire pins (wire-wanxing-direct-dispatch D1) and wanxing-ops-mcp relays.

result.description: The A2A reply. Two producers, one shape: the runner answers message/send with the Message itself (parts/kind + an id), so the id arrives as `messageId`; the facade's own queue-composed receipt (desktop seat queue) uses `message_id`. Both spellings mean the same thing and both are declared here — a consumer pinning only one of them silently loses the id on the other path. fd-wire reads `result.messageId`; wanxing-ops-mcp relays `result` verbatim.

role.description: A2A Message role on the runner's reply ("agent"). Absent on the facade's queue-composed acknowledgement, which is not a Message.

kind.description: Message kind; "message" on the facade's composed receipt.

parts.description: The reply content. fd-wire concatenates every text part in order; a receipt without parts is a protocol error on that lane.

kind.description: Part kind; "text" is the only kind the wire lane consumes.

messageId.description: A2A-canonical id, echoed by the runner's reply. Consumers use it to correlate a receipt with a turn; absent means the caller's own id stands. THE spelling fd-wire reads.

message_id.description: The facade's queue-composed receipt spells the same id this way (desktop-seat queue path). Declared so a consumer can accept both without guessing.

context_id.description: Conversation context on the facade-composed receipt.

contextId.description: A2A-canonical spelling of the same field (runner passthrough).

task_id.description: Set when the turn was queued to a desktop seat rather than run inline.

async.description: True when the receipt is an acknowledgement of a queued turn, not its result.

message.description: The A2A alternative where the Message is wrapped: {result:{message:{parts,…}}}. Consumers must read parts from result OR result.message.

agentCard.description: GET /api/wanxing/v1/a2a/{slug}/.well-known/agent-card.json — the A2A discovery card. Consumers: wanxing-ops-mcp (relays it), any A2A client resolving an agent before calling it.

provider.description: Redacted on the public card: a `url` pointing at a private/unroutable address is REMOVED, not rewritten. Absent url = the provider is not publicly reachable (see redact-agent-card-private-endpoints).

capabilities.description: Defaults to {streaming: true} when the registry entry declares none.

examples.description: Declared example prompts; absent when undeclared (absent keeps the shape).

facade.description: Present only for facade entries; ordinary agents omit it.

url.description: ALWAYS the facade's own a2a endpoint for this slug — never the internal runtime address. This is the field the redaction discipline protects.

chatable.description: The route appends it (not publicCard): present only when the chat gate admits this caller — the same fact /chat/{slug}/status answers. Absent means not chatable.

cluster.description: The route appends it (not publicCard): present only when the pack's manifest declares a cluster. Carries {id, ...}; `slug` + `url` are added when the cluster is a listed service unit.

copilotHost.description: public/copilot.js 的宿主协议（postMessage）。消费者：识律控制台等各产品线的宿主页面——它们只声明三个钩子，消息由这份 loader 收发。这是唯一被消费、又不是 HTTP 面的一块，所以只在该文件里具名、不参与 JSON 传输。信任边界：只有同源且来自自己 frame 的消息被接受（ev.origin 与 ev.source 双检），payload 必须带同一个 slug。

hostToWidget.description: 宿主（loader）发给 iframe 内组件的消息类型。

intents.description: init 携带：宿主能真正执行的动作名。组件只把声明过的意图渲染成可执行——没声明的给普通问答卡，绝不给死按钮。

token.description: identity 携带：每回合的身份。null 表示宿主没有身份，组件按自己的档位走（开放则匿名，否则升级登录）。

context.description: context 携带：页面上下文（page/entity 等），ready 时与路由变化时推。

ok.description: intent-result 携带：动作是否真的执行了。

widgetToHost.description: iframe 内组件发给宿主的消息类型。

slug.description: 每条消息都带；不匹配宿主自己的 slug 一律丢弃。

open.description: state 携带：折叠与否。宿主据此把 iframe 缩到 80px——整高透明框会吃掉宿主页面那一角的点击。

verb.description: intent 携带：要宿主执行的动作名，必须出现在 init 声明的集合里。

hooks.description: 宿主可声明的四个可选钩子；缺省全部降级（无身份→组件用自己档位；无 context→不推上下文；无 intents→给普通问答卡；无 onEvent→没有可观测性，但一轮也不会坏）。

async.description: identify 可为 async（每回合调用一次）；intents 的值是一张 verb→函数 的表，不是函数。

prefsResponse.description: GET /api/wanxing/v1/prefs/{slug} 与 PUT 同一路由的响应（调用键即凭证）。消费者：谦面 `facet prefs` 子命令（paas facet/cli/facet.js）——它读 prefs.callbackUrl / callbackSecretSet / reapMinutes。密钥只报存在，永不回显值。

callbackUrl.description: 回合完成回调地址；未设即 null。

callbackSecretSet.description: 签名密钥是否已设——只报存在，不回显值。

reapMinutes.description: 外部上下文收割窗（分钟）；未设为 null（回落平台默认）。
